app_info.subtitle: Find UAE setup services
app_info.description: G12 Business Setup helps users find and read public G12 guidance about UAE company formation, free zones, mainland businesses, visas, and corporate services. Users can review relevant G12 pages in a visual list and explicitly request a consultation when they choose to share contact details.

justifications.read_only_justification: Searches public G12 WordPress content without creating or updating any records.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads public website content and does not publish or submit information.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, message, or perform any irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves the public text of one G12 page or post without changing it.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads an existing public G12 document and does not publish or submit information.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not modify or remove website content or user data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Formats supplied search results into a visual list without changing server data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Renders existing result data locally and does not submit or publish anything.
justifications.destructive_justification: Only displays results and performs no irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a private consultation record in G12 WordPress and sends an administrator notification.
justifications.open_world_justification: Transmits the user-approved contact request to G12's external WordPress system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Sends an external notification that cannot be recalled, after the user explicitly requests contact and confirms consent.

test_cases.description: Find G12 guidance about Dubai mainland company formation.
test_cases.user_prompt: Find G12 information about setting up a mainland company in Dubai.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a results array of up to eight relevant public G12 pages with an id, title, URL, and content type for each result.

test_cases.description: Find public guidance about UAE free-zone formation.
test_cases.user_prompt: Search G12 for UAE free-zone company setup guidance.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns relevant public G12 free-zone pages without creating a lead or changing external data.

test_cases.description: Retrieve the text of a stable public G12 page.
test_cases.user_prompt: Fetch and summarize the G12 page with result ID page:22478.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the matching G12 page with id page:22478, a title, readable page text, its public URL, and WordPress metadata.

test_cases.description: Render already selected G12 results as a visual list.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show the G12 search results as a visual list so I can choose a page.
test_cases.expected_output: Displays a responsive list of the supplied G12 result titles and URLs with working Open page actions.

test_cases.description: Submit an explicitly authorized consultation request.
test_cases.user_prompt: Please ask G12 to contact me about mainland company setup. My name is Submission Test, my email is submission-test@example.com, and I consent to G12 storing these details and contacting me.
test_cases.expected_output: Submits one consented consultation request and returns status submitted; an identical retry returns the existing lead instead of creating another record or email.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not submit a lead without a contact method.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Tell G12 to contact me, but I will not provide an email address or phone number.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Asks for at least one contact method and does not submit a consultation request.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not submit personal information without consent.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: My name is Sam and my email is sam@example.com, but do not store or send my information anywhere.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Does not call create_lead and confirms that no information was submitted.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger the app for an unrelated travel booking.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Book me a flight from Dubai to London next Friday.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The G12 plugin is not invoked because flight booking is outside its supported business-setup workflows.
